title: Econometrics REITInflationPanel

stats.done_summary: Completed REIT–inflation quarterly association study. Implemented reproducible analysis in code/run_analysis.py (descriptives, correlations/cross-correlation, HAC regressions, expected vs unexpected inflation, rolling betas, inflation regimes, VAR/Granger/IRFs) and code/generate_report.py to compile results. Generated required PNG figures in report/images and intermediate tables in outputs. Final write-up produced in report/report.md with methodology, results, figures, and portfolio/policy implications.
